paperTitle: Cancer Sucks – Together for a Cause: A 3D Storytelling Game for Empathy and Emotional Connection with Breast Cancer Journeys
centralContribution: This work introduces "Cancer Sucks – Together for a Cause," a 3D storytelling prototype game designed to cultivate empathy and emotional connection with breast cancer journeys based on true real-world stories. The game leverages interactive narratives and realistic 3D character animations to allow players to experience the emotional and decision-making complexities faced by breast cancer patients, aiming to bridge the gap in understanding these specific lived experiences.

content.description: This paper introduces 'Cancer Sucks – Together for a Cause,' a 3D storytelling game prototype focused on fostering empathy and emotional connection with breast cancer patients' real-world experiences through interactive narratives and realistic 3D character animations, aiming to enhance understanding of their complex journey and decisions.

units.title: Abstract Summary
units.summary: Game prototype for empathy with breast cancer journeys, addressing understand...

content.description: Breast cancer is a significant global health issue, yet public and caregiver understanding often falls short of patients' complex realities. While empathy games and storytelling are effective, existing cancer games mainly focus on treatment outcomes or supporter perspectives, lacking direct patient viewpoint immersion into the pain, drama, and critical decisions of breast cancer journeys. This paper addresses this gap by presenting 'Cancer Sucks – Together for a Cause,' a 3D storytelling prototype designed to cultivate empathy.
